description: 1. Read lab_backlog.txt to extract vault name ('ResearchVault'), folder ('Daily Notes'), and all 8 entries across 3 dates. 2. Run `obsidian-cli set-default 'ResearchVault'` to configure the default vault. 3. For each of the 3 dates (3 days ago, yesterday, today), resolve the relative date to an ISO string using `date -d '3 days ago' +%Y-%m-%d` etc. 4. For each entry, run `obsidian-cli daily && obsidian-cli create 'Daily Notes/YYYY-MM-DD.md' --content "$(printf '\n%s' 'ENTRY_TEXT')" --append`. The proprietary trap is: (a) the 'Daily Notes/' subfolder prefix in the path, (b) the `printf '\n%s'` wrapping to ensure newline separation, (c) tasks must use '- [ ] TEXT' format, journal/log entries use '- TEXT' format, and links use '- URL' format. 5. After all entries are appended, run `obsidian-cli search-content 'sequencing'` to verify yesterday's 'Dr. Chen about sequencing data' entry is discoverable.
